ANTI_TEMPLATE_NOTES: Avoid generic benchmark preambles, one sentence per hidden requirement, verifier narration, and a polished taxonomy of every failure mode.

CONSTRAINT_PRESERVATION_NOTES: Preserve all three acquisition surfaces, immutable digest/source policy, scanner freshness, exact exception scope, keyed permits, replay safety, and durable allow/deny audit semantics.
Preserve evaluate and verify-permit command names and their documented denial/invalid exit codes.
Do not omit restart, concurrency, malformed-tail recovery, or policy/scanner cache invalidation merely to shorten the ticket.

Point to the solver-visible policy, state, architecture, and operations contracts for detailed semantics instead of duplicating them in instruction prose.
Group package, container, and dependency behavior as one artifact-admission concern while keeping restart and audit consequences explicit.
